_comment: Conformance fixture: divergent branch bindings as parallel evidence, not collision_pending (ADR-0010/ADR-0011)
description: Two branches bind the same Decision to different code regions. The graph layer classifies this as divergent/parallel binding evidence, not as a conflict. Collision requires policy/governance acceptance of incompatible evidence.

expected_behavior.explanation: Divergent bindings are parallel evidence. They become a conflict only when governance or policy accepts evidence that the bindings represent incompatible Decision meaning, implementation, compliance, or scope.
